## Skipped, and why
- **Trimming #11's Imsin oath.** It is a widget with hanja and footnote marks, so I couldn't trim it without rewording a record.
- **Merging #15–#17.** The brief forbids adding, removing or reordering entries. Instead each episode got its own arc, and the boots image now appears only in #16's card and #17's opening.
- **Euija's silence from #5 to #17.** The gap is in #6–#9 (other writers). In my range he now speaks within #18's first beats.
- **Sweet-spot length.** Most of these episodes are still under 2,000 words. I grew the stubs past 800 and didn't pad the rest.

## For other writers
- **#21:** #20's card promises Daeya and Gumil, but #21 still opens on the cavern.
- **#40:** Haesang no longer appears in #13, so his first appearance is now #40 and needs a card there.
- **#23:** It can pay off two new plants: Pumsuk's "sixth rule" from #13, and Gesomun's summer of bowing from #17.
